id: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil
title: Eshet Chayil

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 1
segments.he: אֵֽשֶׁת־חַֽיִל מִי יִמְצָא וְרָחֹק מִפְּ֒נִינִים מִכְרָהּ:
segments.en: Whoever finds a valorous wife— far greater than that of pearls is her value.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 2
segments.he: בָּֽטַח בָּהּ לֵב בַּעְלָהּ וְשָׁלָל לֹא יֶחְסָר:
segments.en: The heart of her husband trusts in her, and he lacks no gain.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 3
segments.he: גְּמָלַֽתְהוּ טוֹב וְלֹא־רָע כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּֽיהָ:
segments.en: She repays him good and not evil all the days of her life.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 4
segments.he: דָּרְ֒שָׁה צֶֽמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים וַתַּֽעַשׂ בְּחֵֽפֶץ כַּפֶּֽיהָ:
segments.en: She seeks wool and linen, and works them willingly with her hands.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 5
segments.he: הָיְ֒תָה כָּאֳנִיּוֹת סוֹחֵר מִמֶּרְחָק תָּבִיא לַחְמָהּ:
segments.en: She is like the merchant ships; from afar, she brings her food.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 6
segments.he: וַתָּֽקָם בְּעוֹד לַֽיְלָה וַתִּתֵּן טֶֽרֶף לְבֵיתָהּ וְחֹק לְנַעֲרֹתֶֽיהָ:
segments.en: She rises while it is still night and gives food to her household, and tasks to her maids.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 7
segments.he: זָמְ֒מָה שָׂדֶה וַתִּקָּחֵֽהוּ מִפְּ֒רִי כַפֶּֽיהָ נָֽטְ֒עָה כָּֽרֶם:
segments.en: She considers a field and buys it; from the fruit of her hand, she plants a vineyard.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 8
segments.he: חָגְ֒רָה בְּעוֹז מָתְנֶֽיהָ וַתְּ֒אַמֵּץ זְרוֹעֹתֶֽיהָ:
segments.en: She girds herself with might and strengthens her arms.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 9
segments.he: טָעֲמָה כִּי־טוֹב סַחְרָהּ לֹא־יִכְבֶּה בַּלַּֽיְלָה נֵרָהּ:
segments.en: She senses that her business is good, [so] her lamp is not extinguished at night.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 10
segments.he: יָדֶֽיהָ שִׁלְּ֒חָה בַכִּישׁוֹר וְכַפֶּֽיהָ תָּֽמְ֒כוּ פָֽלֶךְ:
segments.en: She puts her hand to the spindle, and her palms support the distaff.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 11
segments.he: כַּפָּהּ פָּרְ֒שָׂה לֶעָנִי וְיָדֶֽיהָ שִׁלְּ֒חָה לָאֶבְיוֹן:
segments.en: Her palm she spreads out to the poor and her hands she extends to the needy.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 12
segments.he: לֹא־תִירָא לְבֵיתָהּ מִשָּֽׁלֶג כִּי כָל־בֵּיתָהּ לָבֻשׁ שָׁנִים:
segments.en: She has no fear for her household because of snow, for her entire household is clothed with scarlet [wool].

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 13
segments.he: מַרְבַדִּים עָֽשְׂ֒תָה־לָּהּ שֵׁשׁ וְאַרְגָּמָן לְבוּשָׁהּ:
segments.en: Bedspreads, she makes herself fine linen and purple [wool] are her clothing.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 14
segments.he: נוֹדָע בַּשְּׁ֒עָרִים בַּעְלָהּ בְּשִׁבְתּוֹ עִם־זִקְנֵי־אָֽרֶץ:
segments.en: Well-known at the gates is her husband as he sits among the elders of the land.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 15
segments.he: סָדִין עָשְׂ֒תָה וַתִּמְכֹּר וַחֲגוֹר נָתְ֒נָה לַכְּנַעֲנִי:
segments.en: Garments she makes and sells them, and belts, she provides for the merchants.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 16
segments.he: עוֹז־וְהָדָר לְבוּשָׁהּ וַתִּשְׂחַק לְיוֹם אַחֲרוֹן:
segments.en: Strength and splendor are her clothing, and smilingly [she awaits her] last day.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 17
segments.he: פִּֽיהָ פָּתְ֒חָה בְחָכְמָה וְתוֹרַת־חֶֽסֶד עַל־לְשׁוֹנָהּ:
segments.en: Her mouth she opens with wisdom, and the teaching of kindness is on her tongue.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 18
segments.he: צוֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכוֹת בֵּיתָהּ וְלֶֽחֶם עַצְלוּת לֹא תֹאכֵל:
segments.en: She anticipates the ways of her household, and the bread of idleness, she does not eat.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 19
segments.he: קָֽמוּ בָנֶֽיהָ וַיְאַשְּׁ֒רֽוּהָ בַּעְלָהּ וַיְהַלְ֒לָהּ:
segments.en: Her children rise and make her fortunate; her husband—and he praises her:

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 20
segments.he: רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָֽשׂוּ חָֽיִל וְאַתְּ עָלִית עַל־כֻּלָּֽנָה:
segments.en: Many daughters have attained valor but you surpassed them all.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 21
segments.he: שֶֽׁקֶר הַחֵן וְהֶֽבֶל הַיֹּֽפִי אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת־יְהֹוָה הִיא תִתְהַלָּל:
segments.en: Favor is deceptive and beauty is vain; a God-fearing woman—she should be praised.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil 22
segments.he: תְּנוּ־לָהּ מִפְּ֒רִי יָדֶֽיהָ וִיהַלְ֒לֽוּהָ בַשְּׁ֒עָרִים מַעֲשֶֽׂיהָ:
segments.en: Give her the fruit of her hand, and let her deeds praise her in the gates.
